description: Xbox test account configuration for GameSave tests. Accounts are Xbox Live test accounts in the XDKS.1 sandbox.

noAccountOverlap.rule: No Xbox Live account may be signed into both the PC and Xbox simultaneously.
noAccountOverlap.reason: Xbox Live shows a blocking 'Signed in on another device' dialog that halts automation. The test harness cannot dismiss this dialog programmatically.
noAccountOverlap.enforcement: Each account must appear in exactly one device group (pc OR xbox, never both).

xboxMinimumAccounts.rule: At least 2 Xbox Live accounts must be provisioned and signed in on the Xbox devkit.
xboxMinimumAccounts.reason: Multi-user tests (70, 104, 105, 106) require switching between two users on the same console. Single-user tests use only the primary account.
xboxMinimumAccounts.enforcement: PrerequisiteChecker validates signed-in user count via 'xbuser list' before multi-user tests.

sandboxAlignment.rule: All devices and all accounts must be in the same Xbox Live sandbox.
sandboxAlignment.reason: Xbox Live services partition data by sandbox. Mismatched sandboxes cause silent authentication failures and empty game save containers.
sandboxAlignment.enforcement: PrerequisiteChecker validates sandbox via 'xbconfig SandboxId' on each Xbox device.

sharedPlayFabEntity.rule: All devices must log into PlayFab with the same customId (e.g., 'GameTestHarness').
sharedPlayFabEntity.reason: Game save sync is keyed on PlayFab entity ID, not Xbox XUID. Different Xbox accounts work because they link to the same PlayFab entity via PFAuthenticationLoginWithCustomIDAsync. The call uses forceLink=true and unlinkIfNeeded=true to re-link the entity to whichever Xbox account is current.
sharedPlayFabEntity.enforcement: The --custom-id-prefix CLI argument plus the scenario's customId field ensure all devices share the same PlayFab entity.

accountProvisioning.rule: Test accounts must be provisioned in Xbox Partner Center for the target sandbox before use.
accountProvisioning.reason: Unprovisioned accounts cannot sign in on devkits. Provisioning requires Partner Center access and may take a few minutes to propagate.
steps: 1. Create the account in Xbox Partner Center (or use an existing test account).
2. Ensure the account is authorized for the target sandbox (e.g., XDKS.1).
5. Verify: xbuser /X <ip> list — should show 'Signed in: Yes' for the account.

pc.role: Primary PC account. Signs in on the Windows development machine only.

xboxPrimary.role: Primary Xbox account. Must be signed in on the Xbox devkit at all times. Used by all single-user and two-device tests.

xboxSecondary.role: Secondary Xbox account on the Xbox devkit. Required for multi-user tests (70, 104, 105, 106). Must be signed in before running multi-user tests.

sflashRequired.reason: These tests require sflash.exe for hardware-level Xbox device control (connected standby, shutdown, power-loss simulation). They will be skipped automatically if sflash.exe is not on the PATH.

excludedTests.notes: Tests 13, 42, 98, and 103 were previously excluded but do not require sflash.exe. They now use standard test accounts and run in automation.

sflash.description: sflash.exe provides hardware-level control of Xbox devkits: connected standby (instant-on), graceful shutdown, and hard power-loss simulation.
sflash.installation: sflash.exe is part of the Xbox Developer Kit tools. Ensure it is on the system PATH.
sflash.enforcement: PrerequisiteChecker validates sflash.exe availability before tests that declare sflash: true in their YAML prerequisites. Tests are skipped with guidance if sflash.exe is not found.

setupChecklist: 1. Ensure Xbox devkit is on and reachable at the expected IP (e.g., 10.0.0.105).
2. Verify sandbox: xbconfig /X <xbox-ip> SandboxId  →  must show XDKS.1
4. For multi-user tests, also sign in xboxSecondary: xbuser /X <xbox-ip> signin /i:<userId>
5. Verify signed in: xbuser /X <xbox-ip> list  →  users with 'Signed in: Yes'
6. On the PC, sign in with the pc account (NOT an Xbox account used on the devkit).
7. Set PC sandbox: xbconfig SandboxId=XDKS.1  (then restart the PC test app if running)
8. Kill any leftover GameTestAppWindows processes on the PC before starting.
9. For standby/shutdown/power-loss tests (56-58, 90-97): ensure sflash.exe is on the PATH.
